QUOTE: With the grammars absent, `compiled_languages()` returns an empty set and logs an ERROR. A missing optional grammar makes `_ts_language_for` return None instead of raising... The not-indexed report is meant to name the uncovered file types, so an empty answer doesn't read as "nothing there".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that missing grammars degrade (None/empty set, no raise, files get a path row only) and that a not-indexed report is meant to name the uncovered types. It doesn't mention a router capability gate, but it does state the degrade-and-report substance.
